files.body:
package main

import (
	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	valset "gno.land/r/sys/validators/v0"
)

func main(cur realm) {
	r := valset.NewValidatorProposalRequest(
		cross(cur),
		[]valset.ValoperChange{
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1nqvsxzcgagsps3qe4ffs0stxxzxxaj2nmuem07"), 4), // ValidatorSG
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1zlrdlcs65d6yhschadhvlf3qnw9ruelh9rn6wn"), 4), // Kromo127
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g13tx3jp4spy90dtpyxr7gjp2mfgvjnfxr7kt3ue"), 4), // MictoNode
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1kqdfj5ps9auyj5gzjwt079rlg6rpke9gspqudc"), 4), // Perfect-nodes
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1tv58fhdus9pxfhdzc2srkzreh34r4p66cnqtkq"), 4), // Conqueror
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1fqcddarc4s9qap788t7lksgag4mq7g2gevc8ht"), 4), // NakoTurk
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1u86nekvlf7ppehkf0a6zpdwth5fvh0uljv7x2l"), 4), // kgnodes
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1nez986lpnmyxcrgdzm4kw5l2375hdwvytfujc8"), 4), // Cogwheel
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g1cm5z4slw83sa3x0gttkvv64nx5dc39n2yxk296"), 4), // VinjanInc
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g16dwv69e304eek3y0qn7tfdujtrq6m3wh9tcc9f"), 4), // OffellNode
			valset.NewValoperChange(address("g18dw5qfv2zlh372hh3wvdv9k4ywu7jcgmrnnsep"), 4), // TheGoodEscobar
		},
		"Raise 11 validator(s) to voting power 4",
		"Upsert 11 validators stuck at voting power 1 (watch-mode VALSET_POWER bug) to voting power 4.",
	)
	pid := dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), r)
	dao.MustVoteOnProposalSimple(cross(cur), int64(pid), "YES")
	dao.ExecuteProposal(cross(cur), pid)
}
